I signed up for a data science bootcamp last year and hit a wall month three. The math felt impossible, and I just left the tab open for weeks. I felt like I wasn't cut out for it anymore.

But then I decided to commit to just fifteen minutes a day. That tiny shift broke the paralysis of analysis. Eventually, I finally finished the certificate last week. It wasn't about speed; it was about just showing up when it felt
